description_sq: Apatament 2+1 ofrohet per shitje tek Rezidenca Mirabella ne zonen e Oxhakut. Ndertim cilesor sipas standarteve te eu. Hapesira te gjelberuara dhe ambiente komerciale. Fasade e termoizoluar. Shkalle me ndricim natyral dhe 2 ashensor. Planimetri perfekte dhe shperndarje shume e mire e ambienteve. Totalisht i investuar me materiale cilesore nga vete pronari. Vetrata plastike me dopio-xham. Tavan i varur dhe ndricim me shina magnetike. Mure te patinuar. Rrjet hidraulik multi-strat. Parket ac5(i porositur). 2 tualete, njeri nga te cilet me dritare. Hidrosanitare dhe grupe dushi incaso. 2 ballkone te bollshem. Pamje e lire nga brenda kompleksit, larg pluhurit dhe zhurmave. Vendparkimi i perfshire ne cmim. Punimet jane ne fazen finale.
description_en: 2+1 apartment is offered for sale at Rezidenca Mirabella in the area of ​​Oxhak. Quality construction according to EU standards. Green spaces and commercial premises. Thermally insulated facade. Stairs with natural light and 2 elevators. Perfect layout and very good distribution of the premises. Totally invested with quality materials by the owner himself. Double-glazed plastic windows. Suspended ceiling and magnetic track lighting. Patinated walls. Multi-layer hydraulic network. Parquet ac5 (ordered). 2 toilets, one of which has a window. Hydrosanitary and incaso shower sets. 2 spacious balconies. Unobstructed view from inside the complex, away from dust and noise. Parking included in the price. The works are in the final stage.
